2024_170_may_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: The Troy School District purchasing-card (PCARD) report for May 2024, printed 7/10/2024 and carried on the July 16, 2024 Board of Education agenda, itemizes every district PCARD transaction posted under the journal-entry description "MAY 2024 PCARD EXP." Each line records the transaction date and merchant, the budget unit, the A/C code, the transaction amount and any credit, with posting dates running from 4/26/2024 through 5/27/2024 across page footers numbered through 34. The listing closes with a subtotal of $357,154.47, credits of $4,112.79, and Total Expenses of $353,041.68.
